title: atropis procumbens
intro: Atropis procumbens, commonly known as Atragene, is a flowering plant species in the buttercup family. It is native to Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties. The health benefits of Atragene are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include analgesic, antipyretic, and antiphlogistic effects, making it useful for treating fever, pain, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Atragene include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
